text:
mira_cs: Quick sync for Calypso private/VPC onboarding tomorrow. Need confirmation on: (1) egress rules for our log-forwarder, (2) cross-account KMS flow and who holds envelope keys, (3) IAM assume-role mapping for our aggregator, (4) audit log retention/WORM, and (5) any renewal signals (they're on trial). Short updates please.

alejandro_net: Network checked. Log-forwarder in private subnet -> currently uses shared NAT. Two asks: replace S3 egress via NAT with a gateway VPCE and tighten SG egress to three targets only.

alejandro_net: SG egress example (AWS):
```
Type: Egress
Protocol: TCP
Port: 443
Targets:
  - vpce-0f3e4a6b  (S3 gateway endpoint)
  - 198.51.100.123/32  (splunk.ingest.calypso.internal)
  - telemetry.ingest.redwood.com:443
```

alejandro_net: Also flagged their route table still points 0.0.0.0/0 -> shared NAT. Recommend switching s3 prefix -> vpce and if they need other internet egress, gate via proxy or dedicated NAT in a separate subnet.

taj_platform: I'll drop a minimal Terraform patch for the VPCE + route table swap. Also include a bucket policy snippet to restrict PutObject to the telemetry prefix.

taj_platform: Terraform (trimmed):
```hcl
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "s3_telemetry" {
  vpc_id           = var.vpc_id
  service_name     = "com.amazonaws.${var.region}.s3"
  vpc_endpoint_type= "Gateway"
  route_table_ids  = var.route_table_ids
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_policy" "telemetry_mirror" {
  bucket = var.bucket_name
  policy = jsonencode({
    Statement = [{
      Effect = "Allow"
      Principal = { AWS = "arn:aws:iam::${var.redwood_acc}:role/redwood-telemetry-put" }
      Action = ["s3:PutObject"]
      Resource = "arn:aws:s3:::${var.bucket_name}/telemetry/*"
    }]
  })
}
```

nivedita_kms: KMS plan: Calypso should create a symmetric CMK in their account. Key policy grants a dedicated role in our aggregator account kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey. For short-lived access we can issue KMS Grants at ingest time so we don't add broad ARNs to policy. Rotation: default annual. If they want 90d, note re-encrypt impact for archived data.

nivedita_kms: Minimal policy snippet (conceptual):
```json
{"Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/redwood-telemetry-decrypt"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```

hana_sec: IAM: need an assume-role in Calypso account for our aggregator with a trust policy allowing sts:AssumeRole from our account id. Lock with Condition on aws:SourceVpc or aws:SourceIp if possible. Role perms: s3:GetObject on calypso-telemetry/*, kms:Decrypt on the CMK ARN, and logs:PutLogEvents if they forward to CloudWatch.

hana_sec: Audit: Calypso requested "tamper-evident retention for 4 years." Clarify if they require S3 Object Lock (WORM) or just strong retention + access logs. Object Lock requires bucket-level changes and legal/process hooks.

calypso_ops: Quick reply from Calypso: we'll create the CMK and share ARN by EOD. We require tamper-evident logs for 4 years (legal asked for WORM), and we will upload client certs to the ingest appliance. They want cert rotation every 180 days.

calypso_ops: Also: trial account, month-to-month. If ingest stable for first 30 days we'll consider a 3-month reserved commit. Please note for AE follow-up.

mira_cs: Thanks. Blockers before runbook: (A) Calypso to share CMK ARN and role ARN, (B) cert upload instructions + CA requirements, (C) confirm that switching S3 to VPCE is OK in cutover window.

alejandro_net: Small ops note: Calypso is sampling 100% debug traces. Recommend prefix filtering + 1:8 sampling for non-critical spans for first 72 hours to keep egress down. We'll revert after day 3.

taj_platform: I'll add sampling config and a rollback step in the runbook. Also prepping a dry-run checklist (ingest smoke, key decrypt check, S3 mirror verification).

hana_sec: I'll draft the audit wording for Object Lock and list S3 ACLs/policies we should avoid. If they insist on immediate legal hold workflow, that will be a separate touch with compliance.

reminder-bot: (automated) Runbook meeting: Calypso private onboarding dry-run tomorrow 09:30 PT. Runbook: https://docs.redwood/internal/runbooks/calypso-onboard

mira_cs: Great. I'll compile action items and update the runbook. AE: flag for renewal outreach day 10 if stable. If anyone gets the CMK ARN or cert steps before the call, drop here and I'll update. :thumbsup:

reminder-bot: (automated) Thread archived after 90 minutes of inactivity.
